blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Police arrested a wanted person facing a statutory rape charge in Barlig, Mountain Province, on Thursday, Oct. 15. The arrest was carried out in a joint operation led by the Barlig Municipal Police Station, with personnel from the Provincial Intelligence Unit, Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit, 2nd Mountain Province Provincial Mobile Force Company
